data: In fiscal 2025 (the year ended June 30, 2025), Microsoft reported revenue of $281,724 million, gross margin (gross profit) of $193,893 million after $87,831 million in cost of revenue, and operating income of $128,528 million. That gives a gross margin of about 68.8% and an operating margin of about 45.6%. Both improved on fiscal 2024, when revenue was $245,122 million, gross profit was $171,008 million (about 69.8%, so gross margin actually dipped by roughly one point) and operating income was $109,433 million (about 44.6%). Operating margin rose by about one percentage point because operating expenses grew more slowly than revenue, which increased about 14.9% year over year. These figures come from Microsoft's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, filed July 30, 2025.
